entries.title: Evergreen Branch Library's 20th Anniversary Celebration
entries.description: \nEvergreen Branch is home to Discoveries,nbsp;a public artwork by Larry Kirkland featuring three white marble sculptures of an ear, mouth, and eye that celebrate learning and discovery through our senses.nbsp;Stop by and check it out during your next visit.Special Thanks\nThis event has been generously sponsored by the San José Public Library Foundation, Friends of the Evergreen Branch Library, and Friends of the West Valley Branch Library.
entries.priorTitleZh: Evergreen 分馆 20 周年庆典
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎一起庆祝 Evergreen 分馆服务社区 20 周年！

entries.title: Baby Lapsit Storytime at Berryessa
entries.description: Baby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together by strengthening their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.
entries.priorTitleZh: Berryessa 婴儿膝上故事时间
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 新生儿和婴儿将与照护者通过故事、歌曲、轻摇、挠痒、童谣、图书和游戏一起学习并增进关系。故事时间结束后，欢迎留下来继续玩耍。

entries.title: Music & Movement
entries.description: Music & Movement is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities through songs, rhymes, finger plays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Family Storytime + Stay & Play
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭故事时间及自由玩耍
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 故事时间结束后，欢迎家庭留下来继续玩耍。

entries.title: Bilingual Toddler Storytime / Tiempo de Cuentos & Stay and Play
entries.description: For 30 minutes following Storytime, special age-appropriate toys will be available for children and caregivers to continue the fun together Storytime: 11:30 a.m. to noon Stay & Play: noon to 12:30 p.m.

entries.title: Wee Love Art: Fall Leaf Sensory Painting in Baggies
entries.description: Children will put leaf-shaped cardstock into a ziploc bag and choose fall colors to add in, mixing the paint within the closed ziploc bag.
entries.priorTitleZh: 我们爱艺术：密封袋秋叶感官绘画
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子会把叶子形卡纸放进密封袋，选择秋季色彩加入袋中，再隔着密封袋混合颜料。

entries.title: College Readiness
entries.description: These in-person sessions can help strengthen your knowledge, goals, letter writing, and test-taking skills to improve your college application and set you up for future success!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这些线下课程可帮助你提升相关知识、目标规划、信件写作和应试技能，改进大学申请并为未来做好准备。

entries.title: Educational Park Art Club
entries.description: This week, in honor of Diwali, we'll be learning about rangoli then making art of our own!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 建议 5–12 岁参加。十一月活动：3 日 Frank Buffalo Hyde 绘画；10 日兰戈里排灯节手工；17 日 Theresa Secord 编织；24 日 Jaune Quick-to-See Smith 地图艺术。

entries.title: Homework Club at Edenvale Branch Library
entries.description: Students can get free help with their homework in subjects such as reading, writing, math, and social studies!
entries.priorTitleZh: Edenvale 分馆作业辅导俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 幼儿园至 8 年级学生可在 Edenvale 分馆作业辅导俱乐部接受受过培训的图书馆志愿者指导，获得阅读、写作、数学和社会学科等作业帮助。

entries.title: Messy STEAM
entries.description: Whether it’s science, technology, engineering, art, or math, we’re making a mess learning at the library.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 学习有时会很“乱”，所以每月第 2 个星期二，大家会穿上围裙和罩衫一起动手探索。

entries.title: Wee Love Art: Diwali
entries.description: Delve into the rich cultural heritage of Diwali as we explore traditional symbols, colors, and motifs through hands-on art projects.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 通过色彩鲜艳的排灯节主题艺术活动庆祝排灯节。孩子将在动手创作中探索传统符号、颜色和图案，了解排灯节丰富的文化传统。

entries.title: Intro to Ukulele - Holiday Series
entries.description: This series will take place on 2 dates and will cover the following: November 10: Introduce the parts of the ukulele, how to hold the instrument, and how to read chords.
entries.priorTitleZh: 尤克里里入门——节日系列
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 学习用尤克里里演奏节日主题歌曲，感受节日气氛。

entries.title: 3D Printer Escape Room: Woodland
entries.description: Each month features a new theme and challenge, so come back and see if you can escape them all.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 本月主题为“林地”。每月都有新的主题和挑战，欢迎回来尝试完成所有逃脱任务。面向初中和高中学生。

entries.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines
entries.description: You do not need to have fines to participate!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 即使没有罚款，也可以参加志愿服务。

entries.title: AdvancED: Career Exploration
entries.description: In this workshop, you’ll learn how to explore the details on skills, abilities, work activities, recommended training, and wages associated with occupations that you are interested in for your Career Plan.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: CaliforniaColleges.edu 是加州面向 6–12 年级学生的免费大学、职业和助学金规划工具。本次工作坊将介绍如何查看感兴趣职业所需的技能、能力、工作内容、推荐培训和薪资，并用于制定职业计划。须报名。活动免费，在 Teens Reach 会议期间举行，仅适合 13–18 岁青少年。

entries.title: Documentaries: Holodomor Remembrance Day
entries.description: Books on this reading list will be on display and available.
entries.priorTitleZh: 纪录片：乌克兰大饥荒纪念日
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 影片通过引人深思的目击者讲述，呈现这段关键但鲜为人知的历史，其影响至今仍在延续。相关书单中的图书将现场展示并可借阅。报名者会在活动前一天收到提醒邮件。

entries.title: Family Fun Night: Holiday Cards
entries.description: Families with school-aged children (ages 5 - 14) will create art, crafts, or participate in hands-on STEM activities.
